scope: Native allocation-free outer EPS DSC page bounds
behavior: Outer header and trailer BoundingBox/HiResBoundingBox, explicit atend resolution, HiRes precedence, nested BeginDocument/EndDocument isolation
precision: HiRes decimal metadata parsed directly to f64 after numeric validation; no f32 rounding inherited from VM real objects
limits: 64KiB line cap, 128 nested documents, cancellation between lines and every 4096 scanned bytes; no heap output/scratch
refusals: Missing, conflicting, malformed, degenerate or unresolved bounds; unbalanced document nesting; BeginBinary/BeginData until a stream-aware reader exists
color_experiment: Ghostscript UseFastColor=true leaves tested gray/RGB 0.5 at 127; disabling ICC did not resolve native 128 discrepancy. A requested 16-bit ppmraw experiment was rejected by its header assertion and yields no qualified 16-bit evidence
remaining: Stroke rasterization, source stream support, pixel color qualification and viewer integration
